title: Strategy
description:
Sole canonical Stage-1 strategy representation (DEC-09). A human-readable view may be generated but is marked derived/read-only and is never a second truth.

Hard validation is limited to mechanical properties (DEC-33): parse/schema validity, identity and manifest binding, required epistemic constants, allowed enums and known IDs, factual evidence-reference existence and namespace, and baseline-mechanical reference existence. Word counts, requirement counts, evidence-bridge counts, objection counts and similar semantic-density choices are NOT hard failures here. No hard cap may truncate a material employer requirement. The single mechanically enforced cardinality is the 0-3 personality facet bound, which defines the interface rather than semantic density (Spec 9.4).

source_escape_permitted.description: Explicit source-escape permission (CTR-04). Every downstream stage may open the original authorities and the original vacancy at any time.

material_requirements.description: Every material minimum and important desired requirement. Deliberately NO maxItems: no hard cap may truncate a material employer requirement (Spec 8.3, DEC-33).

evidence_plan.description: Strongest evidence bridges with their claim ceilings. No maxItems (DEC-33).

claim_ceiling.description: What this evidence may NOT be used to claim. Where the source does not establish exact scale, lifecycle, result, ownership or formal mandate, the documented lower ceiling applies (Spec 4.1).

objections.description: Material objections and gaps with truthful reframes. May be empty when none is material; no maxItems.

avoid_guidance.description: ONE consolidated avoid-guidance surface (Spec 8.3). Do not add a second.

counterfactual_route.description: A materially different route, kept only when genuinely useful. Omit or null rather than filling with boilerplate (Spec 9.3).

personality_facets.description: Zero to three facets, selected after factual grounding (DEC-35, Spec 10.2). Zero is valid and is the null outcome; there is no OFF switch. This is the ONE mechanically enforced cardinality in this schema because it defines the interface, not semantic density (Spec 9.4).

facet_id.description: Must exist in policy/personality_facets.json. Private: never appears in employer-facing text.

evidence_refs.description: Every selected facet must be evidence-bound (Spec 10.2, Contract 12.4). Personality never establishes candidate facts or raises claim ceilings.

requires_source_inspection_observed.description: Set by Stage 1 to record that it saw the manifest signal and inspected the original source (Spec 8.2 step 4).

factualRefs.description: Factual evidence references. Resolve ONLY to the three candidate authority files through the evidence index (DEC-34, ACC-08). A BL: mechanical reference here is a validation error. Reference existence proves resolvability only, never semantic support (Spec 14.4).

mechanicalRefs.description: Baseline-mechanical references. A separate namespace from factual evidence; never valid as factual support.

stage1Binding.description: Exact identity plus the fixed upstream hashes Stage 1 depends on (Spec 7.2, Contract 6.4). Fixed comparisons only; no dependency engine.
